steps.title: Analyze and Classify Build Error
steps.description: Identify that 'bg_obsidian' is defined both as a color resource in colors.xml and mistakenly inside strings.xml, causing a duplicate resource merger failure.

steps.title: Resolve Duplicate Resources
steps.description: Remove the duplicate color resource declaration for 'bg_obsidian' from strings.xml to allow seamless resource merging.

steps.title: Inspect MainActivity Java Errors
steps.description: Find and remove the undeclared non-SDK reference 'ScrollViewWrapper' in MainActivity.java to ensure correct Java compilation.

steps.title: Clean Dependencies in build.gradle
steps.description: Remove third-party NanoHTTPD dependency from app build.gradle to ensure compliance with native SDK dependency rules.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Source Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure MainActivity.java uses standard Java 8 inner classes and callback mechanisms.

steps.title: Validate Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Confirm correct XML package namespaces, activity names, and intent filters in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Verify MagicWandView Drawing Operations
steps.description: Confirm canvas painting coordinates, particle physics loops, and standard redrawing methods work correctly.

steps.title: Validate Layout Elements and IDs
steps.description: Ensure layout and ID declarations in activity_main.xml perfectly match MainActivity binding calls.

steps.title: Confirm Resource Color Codes
steps.description: Validate colors.xml contains correct hexadecimal values for the mystical interface aesthetic.

steps.title: Building Magic Spellbook
steps.description: Assemble and compile the debug APK of the Magic Spellbook application with standard Gradle tools.
